about: First Maccabees tells how a family called the Maccabees stood up for God when a cruel king tried to stop His people from worshiping Him.

pages.title: A Cruel King
pages.scene: Old Mattathias and his five sons standing together
pages.text: A cruel king named Antiochus told God's people, "You may not worship your God anymore." He put an idol in God's temple. But an old priest named Mattathias said, "My family will follow God's ways!" His brave sons stood with him.
pages.lesson: Stay true to God, even when others don't.

pages.title: Lights in the Temple
pages.scene: People lighting the lamps in the cleaned temple
pages.text: Mattathias's son Judah, called the Maccabee, led God's people. God helped them win. They cleaned up the temple and threw out the idol. They lit the lamps and had a happy eight-day celebration. People still remember it at Hanukkah.
pages.lesson: Give God the first place in your heart.
